scripts.backfill:local: tsx scripts/backfill.ts .wrangler/backfill.sql && wrangler d1 execute pelican-api --local --file .wrangler/backfill.sql
scripts.backfill:remote: tsx scripts/backfill.ts .wrangler/backfill.sql && wrangler d1 execute pelican-api --remote --file .wrangler/backfill.sql
scripts.ingest:status: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -s pelican-api-d1-read -w) CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$(security find-generic-password -s pelican-api-cloudflare-account -w) wrangler d1 execute pelican-api --remote --command "SELECT started_at, status, posts_added, entries_skipped, error FROM ingest_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 7"
